cases.DESCRIPTION: فَإِن left unsplit; linguistically = فَ + إِن (conjunction + conditional). Unsplit is defensible for compound function word.
سَ extracted as FUTURE_PARTICLE from nominal سَفِيهًا (root س-ف-ه). Host=في is incoherent.

QIYAS.asl: سَفِيهًا (fool/stupid, nominal form of root س-ف-ه)
QIYAS.nisba: سَ does not attach to nominals; FUTURE_PARTICLE only precedes imperfect verbs
QIYAS.shart: Licensed proclitic attachment requires morphological category compatibility
QIYAS.sabab: Diacritic check passed (fatha on س); consonant count passed (في=2)
QIYAS.mani3: NON_SEPARABLE_INITIALS does not include سفيه; lexical protection missing
QIYAS.athar: WHOLE TOKEN should be HOST: سَفِيهًا
QIYAS.baqaya: Engine gap: future particle سَ must be blocked before nominals

cases.DESCRIPTION: وَ extracted as CONJUNCTION from وَلِيُّهُ (guardian). Root و-ل-ي; وَ is root-initial.

QIYAS.asl: وَلِيُّهُ (his guardian/ward, nominal of root و-ل-ي)
QIYAS.nisba: وَ in وَلِيّ is root-initial (FA of root و-ل-ي), structurally identical to conjunction وَ
QIYAS.shart: Conjunction وَ requires lexical check: remainder must be an independent word
QIYAS.sabab: Bare remainder لي has 2 consonants which is >= MIN_HOST_CONSONANTS_CONJUNCTION... wait, conjunction requires 3. Actually لِيُّهُ has 3 consonants (ل+ي+ه). So the check passes.
QIYAS.mani3: NON_SEPARABLE_INITIALS includes ولد but not ولي; gap in protection list
QIYAS.athar: HOST should be وَلِيّ with enclitic هُ: host=ولي + enc=ه
QIYAS.baqaya: Engine gap: root-initial و in wali pattern not protected

cases.DESCRIPTION: نا split as enclitic pronoun from يَكُونَا; but نا here is ألف التثنية (dual marker, inflectional)

QIYAS.asl: يَكُونَا (they-two become, dual imperfect of hollow verb ك-و-ن)
QIYAS.far3: يَكُو + نَا proposed by Hokom (imperfect stem + first-plural pronoun)
QIYAS.nisba: نا in يكونا is ألف التثنية (final n+alef of dual), inflectional ending
QIYAS.shart: INFLECTIONAL_BARE_SUFFIXES must include نا when it is dual marker
QIYAS.sabab: نا appears in ENCLITICS list; bare suffix check does not include نا
QIYAS.mani3: INFLECTIONAL_BARE_SUFFIXES gap: نا not listed; only وا,ون,ين,ان,ن,تم,تن
QIYAS.athar: WHOLE TOKEN should be HOST: يَكُونَا
QIYAS.baqaya: Ambiguous: نا is BOTH a valid enclitic pronoun AND dual inflectional suffix; context needed

cases.DESCRIPTION: After لِ proclitic, host=لشهادة retains the ل from لام الجر+ال merger; should be host=شهادة with article

QIYAS.far3: Hokom: PRC:ل HOST:لشهادة (definite article absorbed into host)
QIYAS.nisba: When لِ + ال merge to لِل, the start_with_definite_article() check fails on remainder لشهادة
QIYAS.shart: Normalization must detect لِل as contracted form of لِ+الـ
QIYAS.sabab: starts_with_definite_article() checks for ال at start of REMAINDER after لِ; remainder is لشهادة (solar assimilation ش)
QIYAS.mani3: لام assimilation: when لِ+ال→لِل, remaining string starts with لش not ال
QIYAS.athar: HOST should be شَهَادَة; article=الـ (merged); PRC=ل
QIYAS.baqaya: Engine needs لِل merger detection in article extraction
